description: Pierce County Finance publishes annual ferry ticket sales through the county open-data catalogue. The native table describes the number of tickets sold by year and lists date, ticket count, percentage increase from the previous year and year fields. Publisher metadata gives 2012 as the starting year and an annual update frequency. The observed data-update timestamp is January 2022; later catalogue edits do not prove that newer ticket observations are available. The public Socrata table and its API metadata provide the access route. The source labels reuse as subject to its terms of use, without establishing a standard licence in this review. Annual ticket counts can inform ferry-demand and capacity-planning work, but ticket sales should not be equated with completed passenger journeys without checking the definitions. The related ferry-operations record contains ridership, runs, delayed trips and vehicles left behind, so it has a different schema.
